HERO.HEADLINE: Hi, I'm {{name}} 👋
HERO.SUBHEADLINE: And if you're reading this, it means I think you're pretty amazing.
HERO.SCROLL_HINT: Scroll down to find out why

ABOUT.HEADLINE: A Little About Me
ABOUT.INTRO: So, here's the thing — I could spend hours talking to the right person about absolutely anything. I'm the kind of person who laughs too loud at her own jokes, has a story for every situation, and needs a solid warm-up phase before I unleash the full chaos.
ABOUT.TRAIT_1_TEXT: I firmly believe humor is the shortcut to any meaningful connection. If I can make you laugh (and you can make me laugh), we're already halfway there.
ABOUT.TRAIT_2_TEXT: I love learning, asking questions, and diving deep into topics most people skip over. Intelligence isn't about knowing everything — it's about wanting to understand.
ABOUT.TRAIT_3_TEXT: I might seem chill at first, but once I'm comfortable? Buckle up. I'm spontaneous, a little unpredictable, and I bring energy to everything I do.
ABOUT.TRAIT_4_TEXT: Whether it's a walk, a hike, or just exploring a new part of the city — I like being active. The best conversations happen when you're doing something, not just sitting.
ABOUT.TRAIT_5_TEXT: I'll talk about anything. Seriously. The deep stuff, the silly stuff, the 'I can't believe I just told you that' stuff. Life's too short for surface-level conversation.
ABOUT.TRAIT_6_TEXT: I don't want to brag, but... okay, maybe a little. People tend to enjoy being around me. I'll let you verify that yourself.

WHY_YOU.HEADLINE: Why You?
WHY_YOU.INTRO: You caught my attention, and that doesn't happen easily. There's something about you that made me think — I want to know more.
WHY_YOU.REASON_1: I noticed something genuine about you, and genuineness is rare.
WHY_YOU.REASON_2: You seem like someone who has depth — and I'm drawn to people with layers.
WHY_YOU.REASON_3: Honestly? My gut feeling said 'she's interesting.' And I've learned to trust that.
WHY_YOU.CLOSING: I don't send this link to just anyone. If you're reading this, I mean it.

GETTING_TO_KNOW.HEADLINE: How We Could Get to Know Each Other
GETTING_TO_KNOW.INTRO: No pressure, no rush. Just a little roadmap for how this could go — if you're interested.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_1_TEXT: Start simple. A 'hey' works, but a 'hey, I checked your website and...' works better. Tell me what made you smile (or cringe — I can take it).
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_2_TEXT: We text. We find out if our humor clicks. I'll probably send you memes at 1 AM. If you reply with better ones, we're officially in business.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_3_TEXT: Texting is great, but voices carry warmth that words on a screen can't. Let's hear each other laugh. Fair warning: I ramble.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_4_TEXT: Something relaxed. A coffee, a walk, a bookstore visit. Somewhere we can talk without shouting over music. I want to actually hear what you have to say.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_5_TEXT: Now we're past the polite phase. Cook something together, explore a new neighborhood, or sit in a park and talk until it gets dark. This is where it gets good.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.STEP_6_TEXT: I don't believe in rigid plans for human connection. If we vibe, we'll figure out the rest together. The point is — I'm open to where this goes.
GETTING_TO_KNOW.NOTE: This isn't a checklist. Skip steps, add your own, go at whatever pace feels right.

DATE_IDEAS.HEADLINE: Things We Could Do Together
DATE_IDEAS.INTRO: Just some ideas. Feel free to suggest your own — I'm flexible (and curious what you'd pick).
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_1_TEXT: Find a cozy café. Order something warm. Start with small talk, end up discussing the meaning of life. Classic.
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_2_TEXT: We each pick a book for the other person based on first impressions. It says more about you than any conversation could.
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_3_TEXT: Cities look different at night. Quieter, softer. It's easier to be honest when you're walking side by side instead of face to face.
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_4_TEXT: Pick a recipe neither of us has tried. Chaos in the kitchen is a bonding experience. Bonus points if it actually tastes good.
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_5_TEXT: Art gives you something to react to together. I want to see what catches your eye and hear your thoughts on things I wouldn't notice.
DATE_IDEAS.IDEA_6_TEXT: Find the best viewpoint in the city. Bring tea (or hot chocolate). Watch the sky do its thing. Sometimes the best moments don't need words.

QUESTIONS.HEADLINE: Questions to Ask Each Other
QUESTIONS.INTRO: Conversations are how you really learn someone. Here are some starters — pick a level based on how brave you're feeling.
QUESTIONS.LEVEL_DEEP_DESC: For when you're ready to go there
QUESTIONS.LIGHT_1: What's the most random skill you have that nobody knows about?
QUESTIONS.LIGHT_2: If you could only eat one cuisine for the rest of your life, what would it be?
QUESTIONS.LIGHT_3: What's your go-to comfort show — the one you've rewatched embarrassingly often?
QUESTIONS.LIGHT_4: Morning person or night owl? And is it by choice or has life just done that to you?
QUESTIONS.MEDIUM_1: What's something you changed your mind about in the last few years?
QUESTIONS.MEDIUM_2: What does a really good day look like for you — not a perfect day, just a genuinely good one?
QUESTIONS.MEDIUM_3: Is there a compliment someone gave you once that you still think about?
QUESTIONS.MEDIUM_4: What's something you're proud of that has nothing to do with work or achievements?
QUESTIONS.DEEP_1: What's a belief or value you hold that you'd never compromise on?
QUESTIONS.DEEP_2: When do you feel most like yourself — where, with whom, doing what?
QUESTIONS.DEEP_3: What's something you wish more people understood about you without you having to explain it?
QUESTIONS.DEEP_4: If you could go back and tell your younger self one thing, what would it be?
QUESTIONS.CLOSING: You don't have to answer all of these. Start with whichever one makes you think — that's usually the right one.

FUN_FACTS.HEADLINE: A Few Things You Should Know
FUN_FACTS.INTRO: Little details that might help you decide if you want to take the chance.
FUN_FACTS.FACT_1_VALUE: Starts quiet, ends in a monologue you didn't expect
FUN_FACTS.FACT_2_VALUE: Dry wit meets chaotic energy. Sometimes at the same time.
FUN_FACTS.FACT_3_VALUE: Quality time + words of affirmation. I'll tell you I appreciate you, and I'll show up.
FUN_FACTS.FACT_4_VALUE: People who can't laugh at themselves. Life is too absurd to take that seriously.
FUN_FACTS.FACT_5_VALUE: I can make any situation an interesting story. Give me a boring Tuesday and I'll find the plot twist.
FUN_FACTS.FACT_6_VALUE: Someone real. Someone who's curious about life, kind to people, and not afraid to be a little weird.

INVITE.HEADLINE: So... What Do You Think?
INVITE.TEXT: If any of this made you smile, or curious, or even just a little intrigued — I'd love to hear from you. No pressure. No expectations. Just a conversation between two people who might turn out to be something great.
INVITE.CTA_SUBTEXT: This opens your email app — write whatever feels right
INVITE.ALTERNATIVE: Or find me where you found this link. I'll be the one trying not to look too hopeful. 😊

FOOTER.MADE_WITH: Made with a little courage and a lot of hope
FOOTER.TAGLINE: Because some things are worth the risk
